headline: General Secretary and State President To Lam attends working session preparing for the Second Session of the 16th National Assembly with the Hanoi National Assembly Delegation
summary: Vietnam's General Secretary and State President attended a session preparing for the National Assembly's second session. He stressed that high-growth budget decisions must align with stability and living standards.
why: Vietnam's national budget and growth targets set the direction of public investment and fiscal policy in one of Asia's fastest-growing economies.
